page.heroSubtext: Record expenses and income, analyze trends, and plan with schedules — all in one place.
Create a free account and keep track of your expenses and income with BetterTracker.

banned.title: Your account has been banned.
banned.description: Please contact an administrator if you believe this is a mistake.

accountNotFound.title: This account doesn't exist yet.
accountNotFound.description: Please register first and then try signing in again.

registrationDisabled.title: Registration is currently disabled.
registrationDisabled.description: A new account cannot be created at this time. Please contact an administrator.

accessDenied.title: The sign-in was cancelled at the identity provider.

emailMissing.title: The identity provider did not supply an email address.
emailMissing.description: Please use an account with a shared email address, or adjust the OIDC configuration.

oidcVerificationFailed.title: The OIDC sign-in could not be completed.
oidcVerificationFailed.description: Please try again. If the error persists, check the OIDC configuration.
